title: Diataxis: a systematic framework for technical documentation authoring
author: Daniele Procida

record.source: The four-quadrant documentation framework, which this repository keeps reinventing under other names. Read for the axes rather than for the four names.
record.kept: The two axes and the rule that a document serves one form: a reader either acts or studies, and the material is either acquired or applied. One quadrant per document.
record.rewritten: The names are this repository's: a how-to guide is a runbook, reference is reference, and explanation is a concept document. The tutorial quadrant is unused, because a reader here holds the tree and needs no lesson.
record.added: A fifth form the framework has no slot for: the advisor, a diagnostic checklist run against a document to find what went wrong. It is not a how-to, because it prescribes nothing, and not reference, because its subject is a defect.
record.dropped: The pedagogical framing and the map of tutorials, which serve a reader learning a tool for the first time rather than an agent working in it.
